# Unity Third-Person CC0 Assets

This directory contains only redistributable CC0 assets selected for third-person action prototyping.

## kenney-protagonists

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-protagonists

- CC0
- humanoid FBX
- idle / run / jump FBX
- four skins
- purpose: Humanoid import / retarget / locomotion smoke test

## kenney-mini-arena

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-arena

- CC0
- FBX subset
- soldier, sword, spear, stairs, walls and arena props
- purpose: melee spacing, camera collision and lock-on testing

## kenney-rpg-audio

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio

- CC0
- OGG subset
- purpose: footsteps, cloth, weapon draw and interaction feedback

See `../../docs/unity-third-person-action/assets.md` for hashes and detailed provenance.

For combat animations, also see the documented CC0 candidates Quaternius Universal Animation Library and KayKit Character Animations. They are intentionally not copied wholesale here.
